column1: # 4MB with two OTA slots and no filesystem.
# The stock default_4MB.csv gives 1.31MB per slot and spends the rest on a
# SPIFFS partition this firmware never mounts: settings live in NVS. The app
# passed 1.31MB when the toolchain moved to core 3.x
# longer fits. Dropping the filesystem buys nearly 2MB a side.
# Deliberately sized for 4MB even where the chip has 8MB. Waveshare documents
# the C6-LCD-1.47 as a 4MB part and ships some with 8MB; a table built for 8
# would not fit the smaller ones
column2: and one built for 4 merely leaves room unused
